name: Vietnamese Pho Rice Noodles (Banh Pho in Mild Bone Broth)
whyItWorks: Flat white rice noodles softened in deeply nourishing simmered beef or chicken bone broth. Naturally gluten-free, ultra low in fiber, and hydrating with essential electrolytes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order plain pho with tender well-done brisket or poached chicken. Request NO jalapeños, NO raw onions, and NO raw bean sprouts.
